# Broader public DoubleFast source recipes

These159 inputs are frozen before the broader C/Rust frame campaign. They
contain38,855,519 source bytes in aggregate, with4MiB per-source and5MiB frame
bounds. Requested overrides are distinct from adjusted Rust parameters and
from any C internal applied tuple. Expected statuses and16 Rust-equivalence
groups are pre-execution hypotheses, not successful codec observations.

Sources are deterministic independent patterns, unchanged ordinary-frame
recipe bytes, and the original official fuzzer/source-prefix inputs with pinned
attribution. facebook/zstd v1.5.7 derived test intent is available under the
BSD-3-Clause option; see `LICENSE.zstd`. Existing frozen C collections and their
historical classifications remain unchanged.

Run `python3 scripts/check_double_fast_interop_recipes.py --check` from the
repository root. The standard-library-only checker verifies immutable source
identities before imports, regenerates every source hash, checks the fixed
manifest/envelope, and launches no codec or subprocess. Protocol, arena proof,
full sanitizer scope and execution requirements are in
`docs/reference-double-fast-interop-protocol.md`.
